interface_name.description: Network interface to use; only required on multi-homed hosts.

no_resolve.description: Disable DNS reverse lookups during scanning.

source_port.description: Source port for outgoing probes (both ramping and scan phases).

initial_dest_port.description: Initial destination port for TTL ramping phase.

scan_type.description: Protocol to use: TCP or UDP.

rfc_compliant.description: Enforce strict RFC 793 TCP handling (affects closed-port response interpretation).

initial_ttl.description: Initial IP TTL value for probes; can be pre-set if gateway hop count is known.

expire_vector.description: Number of hops beyond gateway at which probes expire.

timeout.description: Response timeout in seconds (1-2000 range per man page).

pause.description: Pause between sending packets in milliseconds (1-2000 range per man page).

target_ports.description: Target ports for scanning, specified as comma-separated ports or ranges (e.g., '1-1024,8080,65535').
